title: Bose Drops Lifestyle Ultra Wireless Speaker: Here’s Where to Shop It Online
summary: Upgrade your home audio with this premium and versatile wireless speaker from Bose — shop it for $299.
contentText:

When searching for new home audio gear, it may be tough to find the best speakers that have amazing sound quality that’s housed inside of a sleek, stylish and minimalist home decor design. However, we found one of the best speakers for your home.

Priced at $299, the Bose Lifestyle Ultra Wireless Speaker delivers crisp and rich premium audio at home. It’s now available for purchase at Best Buy.

$299

Buy Now at Best Buy

Although it might look small, it packs a punch in the audio department with detailed, clear, balanced and robust sound that’s large enough to fill a room.

The Bose Lifestyle Ultra Wireless Speaker syncs to your smartphone, tablet or laptop via USB-C, Wi-Fi or Bluetooth — which means you can connect multiple devices to the speaker at the same time. In fact, it even has AUX inputs to connect turntables and CD players too.

Meanwhile, if you have two of these speakers, then you can sync them together for a stereo sound experience, or you could use them as rear satellite speakers when paired with the Bose Lifestyle Ultra Soundbar and Bose Lifestyle Ultra Subwoofer for a complete home theater setup in your living room. The speaker even supports Dolby Atmos, Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital Plus, Dolby TrueHD and Dolby Surround audio formats.

This is great for gatherings, movie nights and watch parties with family and friends at home.

In addition, you can connect the speaker to the Bose mobile app for deep customization and settings. Just sync to your smartphone via Apple AirPlay 2 or Google Cast to stream your favorite music and podcasts from your go-to apps and services, such as Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, TIDAL, Pandora, Pocket Cast, Apple Podcasts, SoundCloud and many others.

The Bose Lifestyle Ultra Wireless Speaker is available for $299 at Best Buy. It comes in two colors: black and white.
